description: Cuts a frame of the given shape out of one of the user's photos and upscales it to a full photo, paid from their credits. x, y and w are the frame's left edge, top edge and width as fractions of the photo (0 to 1); left out, the largest frame is centred. Pass the price the user agreed to as max_credits: the photo's prices from get_shoot or list_photos name it. If a call to this tool got no answer, it may already have started: check list_photos before calling it again.
name: zoom_in
title: Zoom in on a photo
